notes.note: Reviewed final disabled-composer repair after Chromium showed the fixture textarea remains disabled: focus targets the existing labelled composer fieldset when the textarea cannot accept focus; the fieldset is programmatically focusable and write permission is unchanged. Writable chats still target the textarea. The narrow status row hides without a pill, so it is not the parent focus destination. Browser assertions require the disabled composer group to own focus at both widths; unit regression requires the writable textarea.
